18. ORDINANCE ~2™ READING — Amending Section 2.32.020, Department Personnel, of
Chapter 2.32, Fire Department, of Title 2, Administration and Personnel, to amend
provision governing the appointment of Fire Department Personnel. (SPONSOR ~ DR.
ALDRICH)

Dr. Rinne moved to approve on 2" reading, seconded by Mr. Segrave. Motion carried by
unanimous voice vote.

Chief John Kopper, Fire and Rescue Department, provided a staff report. Chairman Cook
commented on the item.

27, RESOLUTION ~ Authorizing the Mayor and the City Clerk to sign a Final Plat for Comea
Subdivision, 2” Filing, a replat of portions of Lots 6 thru 11, and Lots 12 thru 17, Block
404, Original City Plat, south of Lincoln Way, and north of the Union Pacific Railroad
Right of Way, and Lot 1, Block 1, Comea Subdivision, being situated in a portion of the
northeast 4 of Section 1, Township 13 North, Range 67 West of the 6" P.M., City of
Cheyenne, Laramie County, Wyoming (located south of and adjacent to W Lincolnway).
(MR. COOK)

Dr. Rinne moved to adopt, seconded by Mr. Segrave. Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

Erin Fagan, Planning & Development Department, provided a staff report. Brad Emmons, AVI
P.C., provided additional information.

There being no further items for the agenda to come before the Public Services Committee, the
meeting was adjourned at 12:43 p.m.
